playstyle.identity: Kayle is a scaling champion who transforms at levels 6, 11, and 16. She's weak melee early but becomes a ranged hypercarry angel who destroys teams.
playstyle.howToPlay: Evolve at 6 (ranged), 11 (waves), 16 (permanent fire waves). Q slows and shreds resist. W heals and speeds. E empowers auto and executes. R makes target invulnerable. Survive early, farm to 16, become a god.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Kayle spikes at level 6 (ranged), level 11 (waves), and level 16 (permanent waves). AP or AD builds work. She's a late-game hypercarry.

passive.name: Divine Ascent
passive.summary: Evolve at levels 6, 11, and 16, gaining range and fire waves.
passive.details: Kayle transforms: Level 6 becomes ranged. Level 11 gains fire waves on attack. Level 16 waves become permanent and deal true damage. Also gain attack speed with stacks.

abilities.name: Radiant Blast
abilities.summary: Fire a blade that slows and shreds armor and magic resist.
abilities.details: Kayle throws a blade that damages and slows enemies, reducing their armor and magic resist.

abilities.name: Celestial Blessing
abilities.summary: Heal yourself and an ally while granting movement speed.
abilities.details: Kayle heals herself and a nearby ally, granting both movement speed.

abilities.name: Starfire Spellblade
abilities.summary: Passive: autos deal bonus damage. Active: empower auto to deal bonus damage and execute.
abilities.details: Passive: Auto attacks deal bonus magic damage. Active: Next attack deals bonus damage based on missing health.

abilities.name: Divine Judgment
abilities.summary: Make yourself or an ally invulnerable, then deal damage around them.
abilities.details: Kayle makes herself or an ally invulnerable for a few seconds. After the duration, swords rain down dealing damage around the target.
